name: Swooning Over Stans
source:
A summer road trip leads to an unexpected pause in Gravity Falls. Can you capture the heart of one of the Mystery Shack’s most eligible bachelors? Or will you leave empty handed?

[From [url=https://sovonight.itch.io/swooning-over-stans]itch.io[/url]]

A Gravity Falls fan game where you can date Stan or Ford.
translation:
一次夏季公路旅行在重力瀑布意外停顿。你能俘获神秘小屋最合格单身汉之一的心吗？或者你会空手离开吗？

[来自[url=https://sovonight.itch.io/swooning-over-stans]itch.io[/url]]

这是一款《重力瀑布》同人游戏，你可以在其中与斯坦或福特约会。
